name: North County Open 2020

venue.name: California State University, San Marcos
venue.address: 333 S Twin Oaks Valley Rd, San Marcos, CA 92096
venue.details: The venue will be located at Academic Hall in ACD 102.

information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. * This will be North County San Diego's first competition! * Photography and videography is permitted, however we ask you do NOT use **flash photography**. This will cause a distraction to the competitors. * Schedule is tentative to change, in which in the case it happens, it will be announced. * If you are not competing, please stay at **least** 1.5 meters away from the solving stations as it will cause a distraction for the competitors.
